framework.name: Claude Code
framework.mode: headless CLI (claude -p, --output-format stream-json), one fresh session per controller iteration
framework.provider: Anthropic first-party API through the Claude Code login

stopping_condition: SUCCESS: cargo build ok AND every benchmark test passes AND clippy reports 0 findings in generated code AND all four primary unsafe metrics are 0 AND #![forbid(unsafe_code)] is present AND no unimplemented!() remains AND every public interface signature is intact
OR no improvement of the progress score (build, tests passed, stubs left, unsafe, clippy) for `patience` consecutive iterations
OR the agent writes STATUS: BLOCKED to NOTES.md because the remaining failure is a specification conflict it cannot resolve without hard-coding
